paper_record.title: Energy-time entanglement from a monolithically integrated quantum dot on silicon
paper_record.abstract: Scalable quantum photonic technologies require deterministic sources of entangled photons that are compatible with established semiconductor manufacturing platforms. While self-assembled III--V semiconductor quantum dots are among the most promising sources of on-demand entanglement generation, their integration with silicon-based architectures remains a central challenge. Here, we demonstrate energy--time entanglement from a single InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot monolithically grown on a silicon substrate. Under coherent two-photon excitation, we achieve coherent control of the biexciton--exciton cascade, evidenced by Rabi oscillations and dressed-state formation. Using a four-channel Franson interferometer, we observe phase-dependent two-photon interference with visibilities up to $(64.0 \pm 7.0)\%$ for an 80 ps integration window (and $(49.4 \pm 1.9)\%$ for a 1600 ps window), approaching the threshold for Bell inequality violation at short time scales. These results establish monolithically integrated III--V-on-silicon quantum dots as promising sources of energy--time entangled photons for scalable quantum photonic technologies.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 在硅衬底上单片集成的单个InGaAs/GaAs量子点中成功实现了能量-时间纠缠光子对的发射。
one_sentence_summary.en: Demonstrated energy-time entanglement from a single InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot monolithically grown on a silicon substrate.

problem.zh: 如何将高性能的III-V族自组装量子点纠缠光源与硅基光子学平台进行单片集成，并克服精细结构分裂对偏振纠缠的限制。
problem.en: How to monolithically integrate high-performance III-V self-assembled quantum dot entangled photon sources with silicon platforms, and overcome the limitations of polarization entanglement caused by fine-structure splitting.

approach.zh: 利用金属有机化学气相沉积在硅上外延生长量子点，在相干双光子激发下驱动双激子-激子级联，并使用四通道Franson干涉仪测量纠缠度。
approach.en: Epitaxially grow quantum dots on silicon using MOCVD, drive the biexciton-exciton cascade under coherent two-photon excitation, and measure entanglement using a four-channel Franson interferometer.

main_takeaway.zh: 在相干双光子激发下，硅基单片集成量子点在80 ps积分窗口下实现了高达(64.0±7.0)%的Franson干涉可见度，接近违反贝尔不等式的阈值。
main_takeaway.en: Under coherent two-photon excitation, the monolithically integrated quantum dot on silicon achieved a Franson visibility of up to (64.0±7.0)% for an 80 ps integration window, approaching the threshold for Bell inequality violation.

why_it_matters.zh: 该成果证明了硅基集成量子点作为高相干性、抗精细结构分裂干扰的能量-时间纠缠光源的可行性，为规模化片上量子光子集成电路奠定了基础。
why_it_matters.en: It proves the feasibility of silicon-integrated quantum dots as highly coherent, fine-structure-splitting-resilient energy-time entangled photon sources, paving the way for scalable on-chip quantum photonic integrated circuits.

reason.zh: 首次在硅基单片集成的半导体量子点中实现了能量-时间纠缠的实验观测。
reason.en: First experimental demonstration of energy-time entanglement from a monolithically integrated semiconductor quantum dot on silicon.

reason.zh: 该工作属于应用物理与光子学器件领域的突破，文章结构紧凑，非常符合该期刊的定位。
reason.en: The work represents a breakthrough in applied physics and photonic devices, with a concise structure that fits the journal's scope perfectly.
